content: If the number of attempts for an Authentic I - PDU has reached the limit SecOCAuthenticationBuildAttempts that defines the maximum number of freshness values provided by the freshness manager, the SecOC module shall report SECOC_E_CRYPTO_FAILURE to the DET module.
